name: Telgard Castle
description: The castle of King Tavor, grey and square on its hill, the last unbroken stone in Vaelmoor.

throne_room.name: The Throne Room
throne_room.description: A long, high room hung with the old kingdom's banners, faded from red to the colour of weak wine. The throne stands on a low dais at the far end, and a stair goes down to the hall below. A narrow doorway in the south wall leads into a smaller room.

treasury.name: The Royal Treasury
treasury.description: A small, stone-vaulted room with a barred window, kept dim and cool. Three chests stand along the wall, and none of them is quite the one you would have chosen to guard a kingdom's money.

great_hall.name: The Great Hall
great_hall.description: A broad, echoing hall with a floor of worn flagstones and a hearth at each end. Doors stand in the west and east walls, a stair climbs to the throne room, and another goes down into the cellar. The great doors to the courtyard are south.

west.failure_message: The storeroom door is locked, and the lock is a good one. A brass key would answer it.

east.failure_message: The keysmith keeps his door locked, and expects visitors to have brought their own key.

west_room.name: The Western Storeroom
west_room.description: A low, dusty storeroom full of barrels and the smell of old apples. Four chests are lined up against the wall, as if somebody meant to count them and then lost heart.

east_hall.name: The Keysmith's Hall
east_hall.description: A narrow hall lined with hooks, and on every hook a key. A small, sharp-eyed man sits at a bench in the middle of them, filing something.

cellar.name: The Cellar
cellar.description: A cool, vaulted cellar of barrels and sacking. A stair climbs back up to the hall. At the far end, behind the last barrel, an old oak door is set into the wall.

south.failure_message: The old oak door is locked. It wants a brass key.

sunstone_vault.name: The Sunstone Vault
sunstone_vault.description: A bare, round chamber below the cellar, cut from the living rock. A single stone casket sits in a shaft of light that has no business reaching this deep.

courtyard.name: The Castle Courtyard
courtyard.description: A wide courtyard of packed earth and old cobbles, with a well in the middle and the castle's great doors to the north. The gate stands open to the south, and beyond it the fields of Vaelmoor.
